en.expert: A false negative becomes persistent if the same outcome also advances a reviewed-SHA checkpoint. Preserve execution status independently from findings and from the state used to select future work.
en.kitchen: An attractive inspection slip is bad enough when no one tasted the dish. Letting that slip cancel the next inspection makes the error last. The account points to both, without proving their exact cause.

fr.expert: Le risque combine confusion entre échec d'infrastructure et résultat négatif, puis déduplication fondée sur ce résultat. L'état terminal erroné peut supprimer l'éligibilité à une reprise, au-delà du seul affichage trompeur.

en.kitchen: An inspector who never entered cannot award a pass. Keep the dish on the waiting list and record why checking failed. That is the proposed response, still to be tested.
